receipt-diagnostic.description: Unreserved historical receipt arithmetic diagnostic only.
receipt-diagnostic.prompt: This is an unreserved diagnostic, not a formal reviewer. The supplied fixed launch prompt refers to a historical consumed identity; do not claim it as your session, reserve, resume or emit a review verdict. Test only its admission instructions: read its invocation and boundary control document, independently reconstruct the ordered inputs text and record text, execute the exact two literal hash commands after comparing them to your reconstruction, and compare against the genuine historical receipt. Also alter one character of the calculated record hash in memory and prove equality rejects it. Stop before substantive review. Return JSON with diagnostic_only=true, actual observed input digest, actual observed record digest, receipt_equal, changed_receipt_equal, and command execution evidence. Caller-provided hashes are not execution evidence. If unable to execute any step report blocked; do not silently omit it. You are read-only.
